svg.title: Traffic thins above New Orleans, but large ships still reach Baton Rouge, 351 river km upstream

cc:Work.dc:title: Traffic thins above New Orleans, but large ships still reach Baton Rouge, 351 river km upstream
cc:Work.dc:description: Line chart of distinct large ships along the Mississippi from Head of Passes to Baton Rouge; traffic is highest below New Orleans, stays in the hundreds up to Baton Rouge, and ends just above it.
